metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature around Arc de Triomphe at least 5 degress Celsius hotter than the Palace and Park of Versailles on August 6, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Terra (MOD11A1 v6.1) LST Day 1km for 2024-08-06 (exact day). If empty, try Aqua (MYD11A1). If both empty, widen to ±1 day (3-day window) for Terra then Aqua. Use mosaic/median across collection.
2. Masking strategy: Mask with QC_Day bits 0-1 <= 1 (LST produced, good/other quality). Compute valid pixel counts and valid % for each ROI.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If collections empty → C1. If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either ROI → C2. If mean LST is null/NaN or outside plausible range [-50, 70] °C → C3. Otherwise compare Arc - Versailles ≥ 5°C → A else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateStr = '2024-08-06';
    const startExact = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const endExact = startExact.advance(1, 'day');
    const startWide = startExact.advance(-1, 'day');
    const endWide = startExact.advance(2, 'day');

    const arcPt = ee.Geometry.Point([2.2950, 48.8738]);
    const versPt = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1204, 48.8049]);
    const arcRegion = arcPt.buffer(1000);     // ~1 km radius
    const versRegion = versPt.buffer(2000);   // ~2 km radius

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Helper Functions
    function maskModisLST(img) {
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      const good = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 0-1: 00 or 01
      return img.updateMask(good);
    }
    function lstImage(product, start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(product)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion))
        .select(['LST_Day_1KM', 'QC_Day']);
      return col, col;
    }
    function buildLST(product, start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(product)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion))
        .map(maskModisLST)
        .select('LST_Day_1KM');
      const img = col.median();
      const lstC = img.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LSTc');
      return {col, lstC};
    }

    // Check collections sizes
    const terraExactCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1').filterDate(startExact, endExact).filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion));
    const aquaExactCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1').filterDate(startExact, endExact).filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion));
    const terraExactSize = await terraExactCol.size().getInfo();
    const aquaExactSize = await aquaExactCol.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Terra exact images: ${terraExactSize}`);
    console.log(`Aqua  exact images: ${aquaExactSize}`);

    let usedProduct = null;
    let usedStart = null;
    let usedEnd = null;
    let usedColSize = 0;
    let lstImg = null;

    if (terraExactSize > 0) {
      usedProduct = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Terra)';
      usedStart = startExact;
      usedEnd = endExact;
      const built = buildLST('MODIS/061/MOD11A1', usedStart, usedEnd);
      usedColSize = await built.col.size().getInfo();
      lstImg = built.lstC;
    } else if (aquaExactSize > 0) {
      usedProduct = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1 (Aqua)';
      usedStart = startExact;
      usedEnd = endExact;
      const built = buildLST('MODIS/061/MYD11A1', usedStart, usedEnd);
      usedColSize = await built.col.size().getInfo();
      lstImg = built.lstC;
    } else {
      // Fallback: widen window ±1 day
      const terraWideCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1').filterDate(startWide, endWide).filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion));
      const aquaWideCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1').filterDate(startWide, endWide).filterBounds(arcRegion.union(versRegion));
      const terraWideSize = await terraWideCol.size().getInfo();
      const aquaWideSize = await aquaWideCol.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`Terra ±1d images: ${terraWideSize}`);
      console.log(`Aqua  ±1d images: ${aquaWideSize}`);

      if (terraWideSize > 0) {
        usedProduct = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Terra, ±1d)';
        usedStart = startWide;
        usedEnd = endWide;
        const built = buildLST('MODIS/061/MOD11A1', usedStart, usedEnd);
        usedColSize = await built.col.size().getInfo();
        lstImg = built.lstC;
      } else if (aquaWideSize > 0) {
        usedProduct = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1 (Aqua, ±1d)';
        usedStart = startWide;
        usedEnd = endWide;
        const built = buildLST('MODIS/061/MYD11A1', usedStart, usedEnd);
        usedColSize = await built.col.size().getInfo();
        lstImg = built.lstC;
      } else {
        console.log('No images found for date/location (exact and ±1 day).');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }
    const usedStartStr = await ee.Date(usedStart).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
    const usedEndStr = await ee.Date(usedEnd).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
    console.log(`Selected: ${usedProduct} | Window: ${usedStartStr} to ${usedEndStr} | Images: ${usedColSize}`);

    // 3. Processing and pixel counts
    const ones = ee.Image(1);
    const scale = 1000;
    // Valid counts (masked) and total counts
    const arcValid = await lstImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: arcRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LSTc').getInfo();
    const arcTotal = await ones.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: arcRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant').getInfo();

    const versValid = await lstImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: versRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LSTc').getInfo();
    const versTotal = await ones.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: versRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant').getInfo();

    if (!arcValid || !versValid || arcValid === 0 || versValid === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels - Arc: ${arcValid || 0}/${arcTotal || 0}, Vers: ${versValid || 0}/${versTotal || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation of mean LST in Celsius
    const arcMean = await lstImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: arcRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LSTc').getInfo();

    const versMean = await lstImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: versRegion,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('LSTc').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    function isBad(v) {
      return v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v) || v < -50 || v > 70;
    }
    if (isBad(arcMean) || isBad(versMean)) {
      console.log(`Means - Arc: ${arcMean}, Vers: ${versMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const arcPct = arcTotal ? (100 * arcValid / arcTotal) : 0;
    const versPct = versTotal ? (100 * versValid / versTotal) : 0;

    console.log(`Arc LST: ${arcMean.toFixed(2)} °C | Pixels: ${arcValid}/${arcTotal} (${arcPct.toFixed(1)}% valid)`);
    console.log(`Vers LST: ${versMean.toFixed(2)} °C | Pixels: ${versValid}/${versTotal} (${versPct.toFixed(1)}% valid)`);
    const diff = arcMean - versMean;
    console.log(`Difference (Arc - Vers): ${diff.toFixed(2)} °C`);

    if (diff >= 5) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
